title: Native VIXEN target build should configure before scoped build
body: The first queued native witness used the documented wrapper action 'build build vixen-ninja test_cache_codec' and failed before compilation because C:/vixen-native/cacheatomic1/build/ninja did not exist. Recovery used the documented configure-and-build action 'build all vixen-ninja test_cache_codec'. The native wrapper should make scoped target builds configure a missing tree or fail with an actionable command contract.

title: Native VIXEN wrapper should provision Ninja as part of documented setup
body: The first native attempt required manual queue-backed provisioning because Ninja 1.13.1 was absent; tools/vixen-native.sh provision installed it before the recovered build could configure. Native setup should guarantee the pinned Ninja tool is present before build commands, or report the missing dependency with a documented queued provisioning step.

title: Queue replay must include source tree identity for native builds
body: A fresh native source commit was submitted with the same command digest as a prior build; with-test-lock replayed the old green build and wrapper log, so it did not compile the new source. Recovery required --no-replay. Replay keys for build/test jobs should include verified tree identity or automatically invalidate when the worktree commit changes.

title: Queue breaker should distinguish fixed native diagnostics from repeated failures
body: After the Windows implementation changed, the repeated focused command was refused by the queue breaker because earlier attempts on the same command shape had failed; recovery required --no-breaker for the fresh witness. The breaker should key failures to verified tree identity and expose a documented scoped reset when the source changed.

title: Native VIXEN full build inherits WSL provider paths that make Windows Ninja scans fail
body: The queued native full build failed before compilation because Ninja called FindFirstFileExA on //wsl.localhost/Ubuntu/home/liory/projects/undertow/core/src/Undertow.Sim/SaveHistory. Recovery requires the documented configure-and-build action and the native build should materialize or sanitize provider paths before Windows Ninja scans the full graph.

title: Native Windows CTest needs queue-derived parallel width
body: The Windows native CTest route did not receive the queue-granted test width, so the witness command had to pass --parallel 4 manually. Worker rules prohibit width overrides; vixen-native.ps should propagate the queue grant or the native test launcher should derive its CTest width from queue state.

title: Native VIXEN detached base route should derive UNDERTOW_ROOT
body: The queued native-drive base configure failed at  because the detached checkout could not derive  and lacked . Recovery exported  and reran the same queued build successfully. The native wrapper should resolve the paired generated Undertow provider for detached base worktrees, or report the required provider before configure. Tier luna: provider identity must follow the source commit and generated interface contract; effort S.

title: Native VIXEN base comparison cannot configure from a WSL UNC worktree
body: The queued base build command tools/vixen-native.sh --direct build all vixen-ninja ShaderManagementTests test_voxel_injection reached the Windows configure lock on the WSL UNC worktree and emitted no further progress for 930 seconds before the known process was stopped. Recovery used a detached base worktree on /mnt/c/vixen-native/cacheatomic1-base, where configure completed. The native route should materialize an explicit drive-backed detached base checkout or fail early with the supported baseline command. Tier luna: the correct source and build identity plus Windows path lifecycle need pipeline support; effort S.

title: Native VIXEN detached base route should derive UNDERTOW_ROOT
body: The queued native-drive base configure failed at VIXEN/libraries/Text because the detached checkout could not derive UNDERTOW_ROOT and lacked transpiled/textshader/Text/Text.g.h and Text.g.glsl. Recovery exported UNDERTOW_ROOT=/home/liory/projects/undertow and reran the same queued build successfully. The native wrapper should resolve the paired generated Undertow provider for detached base worktrees, or report the required provider before configure. Tier luna: provider identity must follow the source commit and generated interface contract; effort S.
